en.headline: Government sets 420,000-unit housing target for next decade
en.dek: The Long Term Housing Strategy update keeps the 70:30 public-private split and pledges more than 35,000 public units a year from 2027-28.
body: The Government on Monday released the Long Term Housing Strategy Annual Progress Report 2026, setting a 10-year supply target of 420,000 units after projecting gross demand of 419,300 units for 2027-28 to 2036-37.

A Housing Bureau spokesman said the public-private split of new supply will stay at 70:30, giving 294,000 public units and 126,000 private units. Within the public target, 176,000 units will be public rental housing or Green Form Subsidised Home Ownership Scheme flats and 118,000 will be other subsidised sale flats, continuing a shift toward a 60:40 rental-to-sale mix.

The bureau said sufficient land has been identified for both the public and private targets. It will strive to provide more than 35,000 public housing units a year on average from 2027-28 to 2031-32, about 73 percent more than the five-year production after the current-term Government took office and the highest in 25 years. Primary private supply over the coming three to four years is projected at about 96,000 units as at end-June.

The Composite Waiting Time for subsidised rental housing has fallen from a peak of 6.1 years to 4.8 years, the lowest in more than eight years for two consecutive quarters, toward a 4.5-year target in 2026-27. From July 2022 to June 2026, more than 133,000 families were housed in public rental flats or bought subsidised sale flats, the bureau said. Four policy directions in the report include moving households up the housing ladder, enhancing subsidised sale flats, eradicating substandard subdivided units under a Basic Housing Unit regime, and using construction technology to control costs.

zh.headline: 長策周年報告訂下個十年供應目標42萬伙
zh.dek: 房屋局維持公私營七三比，並爭取2027/28起五年平均每年提供逾3.5萬個公營單位。
body: 政府周一公布《長遠房屋策略》2026年周年進度報告，推算2027/28至2036/37年度十年期總房屋需求為41萬9300個單位，供應目標定為42萬個單位。
房屋局發言人表示，公私營新供應比例維持70:30，即公營29.4萬個、私營12.6萬個。公營目標當中，17.6萬個為出租公屋或綠置居單位，11.8萬個為其他資助出售單位，繼續逐步邁向出租與出售六四比。
局方指已覈得足夠土地應付公私營目標，並會致力在2027/28至2031/32年度平均每年提供超過3.5萬個公營房屋單位，較本屆政府上任後相應五年落成量增加約73%，屬過去25年新高。截至今年6月底，未來三至四年一手私人住宅預計供應約9.6萬個單位。
公屋綜合輪候時間由高位6.1年降至4.8年，連續兩季處於八年多以來最低，目標於2026/27年度降至4.5年。2022年7月至2026年6月，超過13.3萬個家庭獲安排入住公屋或購買資助出售單位。報告提出四個政策方向，包括鼓勵市民沿房屋階梯上進、優化資助出售單位、取締劣質劄房並有序推展簡樸房制度，以及推動建造科技控制成本。
